name: Tyrca
source:
The goddess of the eastern sky who governs over spring, and the third daughter of the 4 goddesses.

Also known as 『The Spring Valkyrie』

She governs over commerce, livestock and dance from within the commercial country in the east among the grasslands, Edda. She is known as a goddess who brings hope and harmony.

She is still a young goddess, and while she is still a bit naive she is a very compassionate maiden who harbours deep affection for humankind.

She herself is very much aware of the fact that she is still lacking as a goddess and strives to better herself everyday in order to better guide humankind, mostly through trial and error.

One could say the lively atmosphere of her country is a reflection of her own personality.

「I am Tyrca, the guardian valkyrie of spring! I swear on this blade that I will defeat you!」

Weapon name: Nibelung

[From [url=http://www.ninetail.tk/tde10/] Ninetail[/url]]
